Divine Games:
Fight your way through five battles
in a row at the gods' tournament.

Heroes become strong like gods
through Divine Arts and can use
Blaze Arts to eliminate foes in one
fell swoop.
Battle Details:\nThe rules are simple: use stats\nto fight.

・ Heroes' skills are replaced with
skills specific to the Divine Games.

・ Effects like Legendary Effects,
Supports, and Summoner
Supports are deactivated.

Obtaining Divine Arts:
At the start of each map, you can
choose two Divine Arts to obtain
that will empower all your allies.

Blaze Arts:
Some Divine Arts are Blaze Arts,
such as Purifying Flash. The Blaze
Arts you can obtain are dependent
on the season of the Divine Games.

Using Blaze Arts:
・ At the start of the map, hold
down to display the area of effect.
・ Move the area by dragging, and
release to activate.

Bonus Heroes:
Heroes who match the Release
Ver. are granted HP+10 and
Atk/Spd/Def/Res+4.

More Information:
・ Each attack deals a minimum of
5 damage.
・ Staff damage is calculated like
other weapons.
・ No EXP or SP is gained.
・ Hero Merit is gained.

$aUse $a0 Vignette(s)?

Heroes on whom Vignettes are used
can change their status scene to a
Vista Hero's status screen and will
receive +2 to HP, Atk, Spd, Def, and
Res per Vignette.

Using Vignettes:
When you use a Vignette on a
Hero they receive +2 to HP, Atk,
Spd, Def, and Res, and can
change their status scene to a
Vista Hero's status scene.

Arena Effects:
Increases from Vignettes do not
influence how stats are treated
for opponent selection in modes
like Arena.

More Information:
・You can bestow Heroes other
than Vista Heroes with one
Vignette.
・You can bestow Heroes other
than Vista Heroes who are from
two or more versions before the
current one with two Vignettes.

・You can bestow Vista Heroes
who are from two or more
versions before the current one
with one Vignette.

Effects on Merged Allies:
When you merge Heroes (besides
Vista Heroes) who are two or
more versions before the current
one, if source and target Heroes
have both been granted Vignettes,
the resulting Hero will be treated
as if two Vignettes have been
granted.
